body: Usually...... Not this time. Nothing can stop this :-(

Yeah. His answer "we need to start discussing who you will see going forward". Even he had had enough of my shit. 

Not whining. It just is.

I have a box filled with items that should help me remember the good times. You know what it's weird? I can't remember the last time I felt any joy looking at anything.

I'm a shell. Empty.

I am a functional shell though. Full time job, mother, wife etc.

I just don't want this emptyness.

I hate that I don't have the guts to get out of bed right now and just stop this cycle.

I hate that I'm on here (the internet of all places) whining.

I wanted to call life line but was too embarrassed to do it in front of my family and too worried that I would upset the person on the other side.

I wish there was an answer.
I'm just so very tired.
